# Alnylam Recognized as a Top Employer by Science Magazine for 8th Year in a Row


October 22, 2026


For more than two decades, Alnylam has challenged what's possible in medicine, transforming RNAi from a scientific discovery into an entirely new class of medicines. Today, we're building on that pioneering spirit, advancing a broad pipeline of innovative therapies and exploring new opportunities to bring the potential of RNAi to even more patients.


At the heart of that progress are our people. Across functions, geographies and disciplines, Alnylam colleagues bring curiosity, collaboration and a shared sense of purpose to their work every day.


Being recognized as a *Science* Top Employer for eight consecutive years reflects the strength of Alnylam's scientific culture and our continued commitment to innovation, collaboration and excellence. In 2026, we were honored to earn the #7 spot on this prestigious list.


> This recognition as a *Science* Top Employer reflects the strength of our incredible people and culture. At Alnylam, we translate bold science into meaningful impact for patients. We’re proud of our 'challenge accepted' mindset and how far we have come. However, RNAi therapeutics are just getting started, as we continue to expand the potential of RNAi into all major tissues of the human body in order to continue on our quest to help patients who are waiting worldwide." - **Kevin Fitzgerald, PhD, Alnylam's Chief Scientific Officer**


The annual *Science* Magazine Top Employers survey draws on feedback from approximately 5,100 respondents, evaluating companies across 24 characteristics, including innovation, leadership, respect for employees and workplace culture. The survey recognizes 20 leading employers across the biotechnology, biopharmaceutical and pharmaceutical industries. **Explore the full 2026 Top Employers list[here](https://www.science.org/content/article/2026-s-top-employers-ai-i-do?) .**


*Science* is published by the American Association for the Advancement of Science ([AAAS](https://www.aaas.org/) ) which is the world’s largest general scientific society and was founded in 1848. AAAS includes more than 250 affiliated societies and academies of science, serving 10 million people. The nonprofit AAAS is open to all and fulfills its mission to “advance science and serve society” through initiatives in science policy, international programs, science education, public engagement and more.


We invite you to learn more about[career opportunities](https://www.alnylam.com/careers) at Alnylam,[our science,](https://www.alnylam.com/our-science/the-science-of-rnai) and what makes our[award-winning culture](https://www.alnylam.com/careers/who-we-are) so special.
